## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added a bullet under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` (for any user-facing change)
- [ ] No new install-time permission; a new provider origin is a specific origin under `optional_host_permissions`
- [ ] Page text still goes only to the configured provider; keys stay in `chrome.storage.local`; model text reaches the DOM via `textContent` only
- [ ] No article text, tree built from a real page, or API key in the diff
- [ ] Did not edit `src/demo/` by hand (it is generated by `scripts/build-demo.mjs`) or bump the version
